title: Podcast Layout
description: Smart Visual Director for one clip. Joins the stock pose_estimation output (text lane, one JSON person list per frame — nose/eyes/ears give the face) with frame_grabber's frame table (table lane) and the clip plan from podcast_prepare_clip (text lane): tracks people across frames, estimates who is talking from head-motion (nose vs eyes) gated by the word timing, plans dwell-limited layouts (solo follow, two-person stacked, screen share, full frame, fixed crop, original) with smoothed face-safe crop paths, scores the result (speaker visible %, layout changes, pan speed) and forwards the plan with its `layout` block to podcast_render. Writes analysis/clips/<id>/layout.json and a face thumbnail per person. Producer overrides come from the clip's saved edit: layout_mode and subject (follow this person).

podcast_layout.mode.title: Default layout
enum: Auto (follow the speaker, stack two people)

podcast_layout.sample_ms.title: Detection sample interval (ms) — must match the frame grabber

podcast_layout.detect_width.title: Detection frame width (px) — must match podcast_prepare_clip
